Use when you need the state, live URL or rejection reason of one publication. Do not use when listing: use list_publications.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_article, get_publication · Private data: whoami · Public sink: plan_budget.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_article, get_publication · Private data: whoami · Public sink: plan_budget

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
